prose: Tencent is planning a roughly $5 billion bond offering - including $1.5-2 billion in dollar tranches - to fund AI expenditures, with the bulk going toward chip purchases, per Bloomberg sources; the company told fixed-income investors about the plan Monday. Basis: the article is paywalled and only the headline detail was retrievable.
highlights: Tencent plans a ~$5B bond offering to fund AI spending.
Includes $1.5-2B in dollar tranches; bulk goes to chip purchases.
Basis: Bloomberg paywall - headline detail only.
